title: DSLHyPE-a DSL kernel language for the Exascale Hyperbolic PDE Engine ExaHyPE
summary: We introduce a bilingual domain-specific language (DSL) for modelling compute kernels within a generic solver for hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs). Users express PDE terms, i.e.~the underlying physics, in a familiar native language such as C or C++, while the numerical scheme is specified in a Python-embedded DSL, DSLHyPE. DSLHyPE's compiler lowers the Python description to MLIR and introduces a translation pass that integrates it with native code likewise mapped to MLIR.
